title: ICT in het dagelijks leven van bewoners in Kenniswijk, 2003 : Nulmeting
authors: Kools, Q.H., Serail, S., Marien, J.B.A., IVA, Instituur voor Sociaal-Wetenschappelijk Beleidsonderzoek en Advies,  (primary investigator)
contributors: IVA, Inst. voor Sociaal-Wetenschappelijk Beleidsonderzoek en Advies (data collector)
descriptions: This is a preliminary description: Survey of Kenniswijk ( designated regions in the Dutch cities of Eindhoven and Helmond), aimed at describing the use of information- and communication technology ( ICT ) in relation with themes like: involvement with neighbourhood, ways of spending leisure time, mobility, work, education and learning, consumptive behaviour and use of services. For further information, see also : http://www.kenniswijk.nl
